# Kernel sound-tree watchlist — grep terms for the weekly kernel-sound-watch
# workflow (.github/workflows/kernel-sound-watch.yml), matched case-insensitively
# as fixed strings against the pull-request text of each new tag on
# https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/tiwai/sound.git
#
# Format: lines starting with # are ignored; every other non-blank line is a
# grep term. Section headers tie terms to their source:
#   "# watch: #NN <device> …"  — tied to a GitHub issue; the kernel-watchlist-guard
#                                workflow warns when #NN is closed while its
#                                entries are still listed here
#   "# watch: standing — …"    — lessons that outlive their issue (guard-exempt)
# Keep this current when opening or closing a device investigation — see
# CLAUDE.md "Repo etiquette". After investigating a hit the workflow flagged,
# record the verdict by editing that hit comment (append a "### Triage" section
# — CLAUDE.md has the format) so unassessed hits stay distinguishable.

# watch: #29 Zenbook S14 — Lunar Lake SoundWire platform, CS35L56 amps
zenbook
lunar lake
lnl
cs35l56
rt712

# watch: standing — ALC287 speaker-path/amp-match regressions (#33 IdeaPad Pro 5 class)
alc287
ideapad

# watch: standing — Samsung amp-firmware voicing lesson (#26/#27 Galaxy Book6 Ultra)
galaxy book
samsung

# watch: #39 ROG Xbox Ally X — ALC294 HDA + TAS2781 smart amp; UEFI-calibration
# dropout quirk (b7e26c8bdae70832d7c4b31ec2995b1812a60169; still in vanilla
# 6.18-stable) superseded in mainline by TI SineGainI fix (05ac3846ffe5),
# already carried by SteamOS 6.16/6.18-valve kernels
tas2781
alc294
rog ally
xbox ally

# watch: #50 Yoga 7 2-in-1 16IML9 — PSREF lists "Smart Amplifier (AMP)" on this
# model, but no amp driver binds and no "Force Firmware Load" control appears;
# 17aa:38dc has no entry in the ALC269/ALC287 quirk table while its neighbours
# do (38d5/38d6/38df/38e0 -> TAS2781_I2C, 38d2/38d7/38cf -> YOGA9 bass-spk-pin).
# A quirk landing for this SSID would be the answer. NOT a hidden-woofer case
# (#53 class): PSREF gives this model "Stereo speakers, 2W x2", so its single
# speaker pin is correct and the gap is the amp alone.
38dc
16iml9
yoga 7 2-in-1

# watch: standing — regressions to the pin fixup a tested device depends on
# (#53 Yoga 7 16IAH7, closed 2026-08-06). Its BIOS reports the woofer pin 0x17
# unconnected, so only the tweeters are driven until b70f007a9fc6 applies
# (merged for 7.2, no Cc: stable); the device is in the README tested table on
# that basis, which is why the watch outlives the issue. Narrow on purpose:
# *new* pin-adding fixups need no watching here, because the weekly
# speaker-pin-quirks workflow rebuilds _SPEAKER_PIN_QUIRKS from upstream and
# opens a PR when one lands.
yoga9-bass-spk-pin
bass-spk-pin
16iah7
386a

# watch: standing — regression risk to confirmed-working devices on churning
# kernel paths: ASUS TUF A15 (#34) rides AMD ACP (redesigned in 7.2); Zenbook
# 14 UX3405 (#19/#24) saw adjacent-model quirks land this cycle
asus tuf
ux3405
um3405

# watch: #67 XiaoXin Pro 14GT AGP11 (83SG) — ALC287 codec SSID 17aa:3941 has no
# entry upstream, while its PCI SSID 17aa:38d5 matches another machine's
# TAS2781 entry ("Yoga S990-16 Pro IMH YC Quad"), so the codec is handed a
# smart-amp binding keyed to a Yoga Pro 9. Watching for an entry keyed to this
# machine — either a pin fixup (its AGP11 sibling publishes 4 drivers) or an
# amp one. Terms are the ids only: alc287/tas2781/bass-spk-pin are already
# watched above and repeating them would double every hit comment.
3941
38d5
xiaoxin
agp11
